blocks.text: PLDT did not let its third-set lapse hamper its goal, eventually turning back Galeries Tower, 25-13, 25-23, 23-25, 25-18, to bolster its semifinals bid in the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference on Saturday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
